obligations.obligation: Three objects in Vastin's order, physical: the records (six years, suppressed); the copied page (a title and a place, nothing else); the deep-layer log line with the redaction
obligations.evidence: 'a courier's flat … the sheets lay flat in the order somebody had put them in'; 'four lines, in a square hand, folded twice, a word and a place'; 'a bar of ink the width of a thumb, laid on with a brush'.

obligations.obligation: The Compact measured, mapped and hid it; 'more than four'; identical failure logged in every year
obligations.evidence: 'They wrote it the same way six years ago that they wrote it last summer. Nobody in six years has put a second word in that column.' / 'More than four … Places we didn't find.' No new site named.

obligations.obligation: Karis opens the records like bread — staged as method
obligations.evidence: 'She opened the Compact's six years the way a starving person opens bread — not fast; completely — and the sorting was the eating: sheet by sheet, by site and then by year'.

obligations.obligation: Seln does the arithmetic in silence; Cael sees and does not know
obligations.evidence: 'Seln had gone still … had heard a date and a word and had gone still … and he did not say the answer.' / 'Cael did not know what it was.'

obligations.obligation: Vastin's want — nothing to do; Karis owns the response
obligations.evidence: 'Then there was nothing for the man to do.' section; 'watched her take it the way a man watches a thing he used to do being done by somebody else'.

obligations.obligation: Cael's hand near the page, not on it — in the body
obligations.evidence: 'a hand's width, a little less — and did not close it'; Lira's look; 'the page stayed where it was'.

obligations.obligation: 'Architect' as the record's word, read aloud once; never read in any stratum; no theory
obligations.evidence: '—by the design of the Architect, whose apparatus this is, as the lower archive at Treswick holds in full—' / 'It's a word I have never read in any stratum … It's a title, not a name'.

obligations.obligation: The two roads in the closing image; close on the image
obligations.evidence: Final two paragraphs: void roads east under last frost; the maintained road west, three days, to a city on the Line.

inventions: The courier's flat (oilcloth over pasteboard) as the records' form; the office's 'anomaly' column with its three-letter abbreviation; the technician's ruled sheet and the brush-laid redaction bar.

The citation's wording — 'by the design of the Architect, whose apparatus this is, as the lower archive at Treswick holds in full' — as a clerk's citation line, deliberately without 'built', 'deployed', or a date.
state_change_proposals: Day 277, evening: the handover. The records (six years of survey abstracts, more than four sites — count unstated) are on Karis's table; the completion report from the Stair is among them ('It went into this').
The citation page — a title ('the Architect') and a place (Treswick's lower archive) — set apart; untouched by Cael.
The deep-layer log line copied into Karis's notebook with its date (six years back) and the bar; 'not read'.
Seln's silent sum noted by Cael, unexplained. Vastin sent to bed by Karis and Oryn.
deviations: The word 'apparatus' appears in the citation (the card's Ch15 language has 'designed and deployed'; here only 'by the design of' and 'whose apparatus this is' — no 'built', 'deployed', 'four hundred years').
